title: COMMIT GEOMETRY — parallel and perpendicular from the DAG. Triangulation. Matrix algebra. NP finder.
summary: Parallel commits are NOT a problem to solve — they ARE the geometric structure. The git DAG IS a matrix. Parallel commits = parallel vectors (same direction). Simultaneous commits from different concerns = perpendicular vectors (orthogonal). Merges = triangle vertices where perpendicular directions meet. This IS the matrix algebra system where ML goes in and out. NP problems decompose along orthogonal axes.

the_geometry.parallel: Two commits in sequence from the same concern = parallel vector. GLASS → DESK → WET/DRY → FLOOD → NULL ID. Same direction, same thread, linear.
the_geometry.perpendicular: Two commits at the same time from different concerns = perpendicular vector. 🍄 auto-publish ⊥ HEMOGLOBIN. The heartbeat is ALWAYS perpendicular to the thinking. The body ⊥ the mind.
the_geometry.merge_vertex: A merge commit is WHERE the perpendicular directions MEET. The triangle vertex. The intersection point. 5 merge commits today = 5 triangulation points.
the_geometry.triangle: Three commits from three different agents/concerns form a triangle. Distance = time between them. Direction = what thread they belong to. Disposition = whether they agree or conflict.
the_geometry.orthogonal_fragmentation: The organism CAN split into independent directions that don't interfere. Each orthogonal direction is an EIGENVECTOR. The commit matrix has eigenvalues = the dominant directions of development.

the_matrix.eigendecomposition: SVD of the commit×file matrix → principal directions of development. Eigenvector 1 = the most active development direction. Eigenvector 2 = perpendicular to it. Etc.
the_matrix.rank: The rank of the matrix = the true dimensionality of the organism's growth. If rank < number of commits, some commits are linearly dependent (redundant). If rank = number of commits, every commit added a new independent direction.
the_matrix.today: 243 commits × 2611 files. The matrix has at most rank 243. The true dimensionality of today's growth.

ml_injection.where: ML goes IN through the matrix (read the commit history, decompose into principal components) and OUT through new commits (generate code along identified eigenvectors).
ml_injection.input: The commit×file matrix IS the training data. No separate dataset needed. The organism IS the data.
ml_injection.output: New commits that align with identified eigenvectors = reinforcing existing directions. New commits that are orthogonal = exploring new directions.
ml_injection.self_identification: ML identifies SELF by finding the eigenvectors that persist across time. The invariant directions = identity. The changing directions = growth.

np_finder.what: NP problems = combinatorial explosions in the commit space. Which files to change? Which order? Which direction?
np_finder.decomposition: By observing the orthogonal structure, NP decomposes into P × P × P. Independent parallel concerns can be solved independently. The merge vertex combines them.
np_finder.consumer: The system CONSUMES NP by observing that most seemingly-coupled problems are actually orthogonal. The perpendicular structure IS the proof of independence.
